About Me

Blending code logic with design aesthetics

I am a second-year Bachelor of Science in Computer Science student at Norzagaray College, where I continue to build my knowledge of programming, design, and technology. Outside my academic work, I am passionate about game development and layout design because they allow me to combine creativity with logical thinking. I enjoy exploring how colors, typography, spacing, and interactive elements can work together to create digital experiences that feel clear, welcoming, and enjoyable.

I believe that good design starts with understanding people and the problems they need to solve. I value clear communication, creative thinking, patience, and being open to feedback throughout the process. Whether I am developing an idea, arranging a layout, or learning a new tool, I try to consider both how something looks and how well it works. I want to keep improving my skills, learn from every project, and create useful and engaging experiences that communicate ideas in a thoughtful way.
